# elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic Daily Update (Apr 12, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on April 12, 2026, focused on maintaining codebase compatibility and cleaning up the repository. The team successfully addressed a critical TypeScript type compatibility issue following core framework updates and performed a comprehensive cleanup of stale issues and third-party plugin proposals to streamline the project's focus.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Type Safety and Compatibility
*   Resolved a TypeScript build error (`TS2769`) by casting the `emitEvent` payload to `EventPayload`. This ensures compatibility with the `EventPayloadMap` following the `@elizaos/core` alpha.115 update. ([#16](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/pull/16))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   None.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Repository Maintenance and Stale Issue Cleanup
*   Closed a large volume of stale issues (8+ months old) and non-actionable outreach threads to improve repository clarity. This included issues related to V3 goals, security roles, Twitter mention bugs, documentation 404s, and various feature requests for streaming, Pump.fun migration, and HyperEVM support. ([#5386](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/5386), [#4720](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/4720), [#4921](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/4921), [#4855](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/4855), [#4908](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/4908), [#4909](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/4909), [#5060](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/5060), [#4947](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/4947), [#4997](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/4997), [#5155](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/5155), [#5172](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/5172), [#5183](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/5183), [#5181](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/5181), [#5244](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/5244))

### Third-Party Plugin and Integration Proposals
*   Closed numerous proposals for third-party plugins and integrations, directing contributors to develop these in their own repositories under `elizaOS-plugins` and publish them to npm. ([#6634](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6634), [#6635](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6635), [#6640](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6640), [#6644](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6644), [#6646](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6646), [#6668](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6668), [#6688](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6688), [#6695](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6695), [#6699](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6699), [#6700](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6700), [#6707](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6707), [#6706](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6706), [#6708](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6708), [#6711](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6711), [#6548](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6548), [#6581](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6581))

## NEW ISSUES
*   None.

## ACTIVE ISSUES
*   [#6514](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6514) (Inter-Agent Coordination): Discussion regarding cross-instance communication and capability exchange. Participants highlighted the need for persistent peer relationships, behavioral history (WTRMRK), and on-chain credential verification (Insumer) to solve the cold-start problem for autonomous agents.
*   [#6365](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/issues/6365) (AI Agent Payment Implementation): Extensive discussion on payment infrastructure, identity verification, and trust layers. Contributors debated the necessity of pre-transaction reputation checks, sanctions screening, and the integration of marketplace layers like MAXIA with payment rails like Coin Railz.
